behavior_delta: After the bounded union detachment and before any read of union format/state/digest/prt_identities, _union_version requires exact str equality of union module/design_freeze_sha256/scheme/producer_sha256 with the pinned v3 values. Absence, a non-str value, a mismatch or a non-object union fires CP1_UNION_VERSION (ordered before CP1_IDENTITY_UNION) and returns without setting state.union. Independent S4-S6 causes still accumulate as in v1 (PRT3 bytes are read and verified and their definitions executed), but decide_and_commit is never invoked: HELD.
